single.title: Update this mod?
single.intro: This mod is part of the following collections:
single.curator_version: These collections use a version selected by their curator.
single.caution: If the curator recommends this update, you can continue. Otherwise, updating may cause the collection to stop working as intended.
single.acknowledge: I understand that updating this mod may affect my collection.

batch.title: Update these mods?
batch.intro: Some of these mods are part of the following collections:
batch.curator_version: These collections use a version selected by their curator.
batch.caution: If the curator recommends these updates, you can continue. Otherwise, updating may cause the collections to stop working as intended.
batch.acknowledge: I understand that updating these mods may affect my collection.

manualInstaller.title: Choose install folder
manualInstaller.intro: Choose the folder inside the game directory to install {{modName}} into.
manualInstaller.invalidFolder: The folder must be inside the game directory
manualInstaller.useAsDefault: Use this folder for future mods for this game
manualInstaller.useForAll_one: Use this folder for all remaining mods ({{count}} more)
manualInstaller.useForAll_other: Use this folder for all remaining mods ({{count}} more)

sourceUnknown.title: Mod source unknown
sourceUnknown.body: Vortex doesn't know where this mod came from, so it can't check for updates.

notIdentified.title: Mod not identified
notIdentified.body: Vortex can't identify this mod, so some features, including checking for updates and adding it to Collections, won't work.

chooseFile.title: Choose update file
chooseFile.body: Vortex can't determine the correct update automatically.

rowActions.installDescription: Installs the mod into your game, where it can be enabled or disabled.
